g.title: RFS
g.text: REFEEDING SYNDROME · Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map
The disease is a flux mismatch: Λ
. The clinician sets the numerator, the starvation history sets the denominator.
The compartment the laboratory measures (ECF phosphate, 14 mmol) is 0.06 % of the pool at risk (total body phosphorus, 22 800 mmol).

g.title: NOTE_SCALE
g.text: WHY THE BLOOD TEST CANNOT WARN YOU
The measured compartment is 0.06 % of the pool. During
starvation, catabolic release from shrinking cells and
maximal renal conservation hold the SERUM normal while
the stores empty. A normal admission phosphate is not
reassurance; it is the expected finding.
